title: The Next Chapter of Spotify’s Audiobooks Speaks Volumes About Where the Streamer Is Heading
summary: Spotify executives have described audiobook streamers as "very valuable users," and now they're rolling it out to customers worldwide.
contentText:

“We’re building products that help people discover new books, that give them more chances to enjoy them, and that weave stories into every single part of their day, because nobody ever regrets time spent with a good book,” Smith said during a press briefing the company held on Monday (Oct. 5).

Page Match has “quickly become one of our most consistently used and highest performing product launches,” Owen Smith , Spotify’s global head of books, said at the May investor day. “We are creating healthy reading habits and high-value behavior that becomes even more powerful when it sits inside the broader Spotify ecosystem.”

The company also shares data about audiobook consumption and marketing information with authors and publishers through Spotify for Authors. It has also invested in Spotify Audiobooks Selects, which gives independent authors the tools to make professional-grade audiobooks and offers an additional AI voice-over tool that uses ElevenLabs’ technology.
